newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MAIZE, WHEAT MIXED, BARLEY FUTURES DROP IN HUNGARY.
newsitem.headline: MAIZE, WHEAT MIXED, BARLEY FUTURES DROP IN HUNGARY.

text.p: Maize and milling wheat futures finished mixed while barley futures continued their plunge on the grain section of the Budapest Commodity Exchange, traders said on Tuesday.
"The area planted with autumn barley is considerably larger than the market previously thought," said Gabor Herczeg of LaSalle.
He added that the area is 13 percent larger than the year before and prices rose earlier to unsustainable heights, especially compared with maize prices.
Feed barley dropped by the daily allowed 400 forints per tonne for all maturities except March which remained unchanged at 26,560 forints.
Maize prices ended mixed with the July maturity giving more than one third of the daily turnover of the grains section in volume terms.
Herczeg said producers are finally coming to the market after a long wait.
This and the fact that there is significant carry-over stock for both maize and wheat, is likely to maintain prices at relatively low levels for the old (1996) stock.
Total turnover was a below average 843 contracts or 321.25 million forints, with maize accounting for 433 contracts and milling wheat for 324.
Lot size is 20,000 kgs for all contracts.
